cases.reason: The prompt asks 'Which parameter specifies the expected HTTP status code string for login success conditions in a CloudFront protected application endpoint?'. This grammatical usage of 'specifies' inquires about schema field function/definition rather than expressing imperative user configuration intent ('Where do I configure/specify...'). With all provider roles available in source-all-roles.json, both documentation/resources/protected_application and documentation/data-sources/protected_application exist in the canonical documentation and expose the identical 'status' enum attribute under cloudfront.protected_endpoints.flow_label.authentication.login.transaction_result.success_conditions. Because role-distinguishing intent is absent and both valid destinations exist, the prompt is ambiguous between the resource and data-source roles.

The prompt asks 'Which parameter specifies the ending IPv6 address for a DHCP address pool on a VoltStack site ethernet interface router?'. This grammatical phrasing inquires about parameter function rather than expressing imperative user configuration intent ('Where do I configure/specify...'). With full provider roles available in source-all-roles.json, both documentation/resources/voltstack_site and documentation/data-sources/voltstack_site exist in the canonical documentation and expose the identical 'end_ip' parameter under custom_network_config.interface_list.interfaces.ethernet_interface.ipv6_auto_config.router.stateful.dhcp_networks.pools. Because the prompt omits role-specifying context, the query is ambiguous between the resource and data-source roles.
